reviewed_by: Claude review of MCP JSON import: backend, docs, schema, and the approved import dialog UI
reason: Adds mcp_import.py plus POST /mcp-servers/import, GET /mcp-servers/export and `nebula-core mcp import|export`. Imported mcpServers/VS Code servers become disabled, untrusted McpServerProfile records; ${VAR} values become env: references, literal credentials go to the vault/session store or are rejected, and replace resets trust and capabilities. test_mcp_import.py covers preview, apply, secret handling and rollback, invalid-entry messages, conflicts, export round trip, the API routes and the CLI. test_cli.py covers the CLI module the new commands were added to; the credential API test and OpenAPI contract test cover the shared credential store and the new routes' registration. The MCP probe now treats only JSON-RPC -32601 (method not found) as an optional-list miss instead of matching message text, and requests resources/prompts only when the server advertises them; test_mcp_probe.py covers both directions (non-standard messages no longer fail the probe, real errors mentioning 'not found' are no longer swallowed), and the two existing stdio/HTTP probe tests in test_harnesses.py cover unchanged discovery. Documentation: docs/MCP-SERVERS.md is the file-format reference, linked from docs/NEBULA3.md, and a new mcp-servers operator-help article lets the analyst assistant answer format and troubleshooting questions. The stale release-boundary article no longer says MCP is out of scope. test_operator_help.py pins the article list and routing of an MCP import question; the chat help-retrieval test and the package member audit cover the bundled corpus. JSON Schema: mcp_config_json_schema() builds the import-file schema, with the nebula block generated from McpImportOptions; it is checked in as docs/mcp-servers.schema.json and served by `nebula-core mcp schema` and GET /mcp-servers/schema. New tests in test_mcp_import.py pin the checked-in file to the generator, validate the documented examples, reject the same forms import rejects, and cover the route and command. UI: McpImportDialog (paste or choose a file, example, format guide and schema links, Core dry-run preview, replace re-preview, import) is wired into HarnessSettings with an Import button, an empty-state entry, a post-import notice, and next-step hints on cards; Probe is disabled for untrusted stdio servers. The Edit MCP dialog no longer resets a saved fixed cwd to the workspace policy, which the real-Core journey exposed. Frontend tests cover the dialog, settings wiring, and client mapping. The new mcp-import Playwright area runs the whole journey against real Core at a LAN origin with production assets on the 8 assistant-real profiles, including a real stdio probe of tests/v3/fixtures/fake_mcp_server.py. test_playwright_impact.py covers the manifest change.
exclusions: No full suites. ui/tests/** and ui/playwright.config.ts are shared files: the only change is one new real-Core test and adding 'mcp import' to the assistant-real grep, so coverage is the new mcp-import area rather than a full run. Mocked interface.spec visual tests were checked by hand: 'critical workspaces remain visually stable' fails identically on the Findings baseline with and without this change (a pre-existing, environment-dependent 21497-pixel diff), while the Settings Zero Dark baseline and the shared dialog audit pass. No native (Tauri) change. Physical devices were not available; mobile coverage is emulated Chromium and WebKit.
